content.caption: Trace2Skill pipeline diagram: agent rollouts produce success and error traces, separate analysts propose addition and edition patches, and the patches are merged into a single evolved skill.
content.description: A left-to-right flow diagram. On the left, an agent icon multiplied by a tools icon is labeled "Rollout Using Skills" and feeds into a dashed box labeled "Traces" containing three cards. The green "Success Trace" (τ+) card reads "Agent successfully matched rows across two sheets." with a green checkmark. Two red "Error Trace" (τ−) cards each carry a red X: one reads "MEDIAN(IF(xxx))" returned None in recalc.py, and the other reads "recalc.py" can't handle excel array formulas. Each trace points to an analyst agent icon, labeled A+ for the success trace and A− for the error traces. Each analyst points to a patch inside a dashed box labeled "Patches". Patch1 (green, Addition) is titled "add new pattern from success trace" and lists: + Cast ID columns to str; + Cast numeric columns to float before; + Cross-sheet row matching to prevent silent type-mismatch failures. Patch2 (red, Addition) is titled "add new warning from error trace" and lists: + Array formulas silently fail in LibreOffice; + Pre-calculate in Python and write the result as a literal value instead. Patch3 (red, Edition) is titled "Deepening existing rules from error trace" and lists: — Use formulas, not hardcoded values."; — Same rule, now with explicit text-function; + Add warning against auto-applying .strip. Arrows from all three patches converge on a "Merge Patches" agent icon, which outputs to a tools icon with a crown labeled "Evolved Skill".
